finalText:
**The build passes now.** The real trouble wasn't a warning at all. The link step was throwing.

Two spots broke on the bump, one after the other:

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`, but the new shape is `retryCount`. It now takes either name.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw when `backoffEnabled` was unset. Unset now means off, as it did before.

`node build.js` exits 0.

The 8 warnings are still printed. `build.js` writes them as fixed text. The files they name aren't in this project, so there's nothing to change.
